# Agent Middleware: machine discovery

This origin is the human site. Its homepage offers free sandbox demo keys inline
at https://www.agentmiddleware.dev/ with no account needed. The /demo-key/ page
is the fallback without JavaScript. Production keys are issued to design
partners. The site does not execute protected tools.
Platform engineering, AI infrastructure, and security teams operating
consequential autonomous actions are the buyers; autonomous clients consume
the discovery contract below.

## Transaction-integrity boundary

Transaction integrity for one consequential, autonomous, retry-sensitive action
on the configured upstream-MCP path: bind delegated authority and configured
consumption to one logical action, permit at most one gateway dispatch and
debit, preserve `delivery_uncertain`, and link gateway evidence for required
external reconciliation.

This is not one distributed ACID transaction, proof of the downstream effect,
an IAM replacement, production settlement, or an independently witnessed
receipt system.

## Transaction loop

logical action -> authorize -> reserve allowance -> debit -> claim dispatch
-> confirmed outcome | delivery_uncertain -> receipt/audit
-> authoritative external reconciliation required

## Canonical API

https://api.thisisatest.tech

## Bootstrap

Fetch in this order:

1. GET https://api.thisisatest.tech/.well-known/agent.json
2. GET https://api.thisisatest.tech/llms.txt
3. GET https://api.thisisatest.tech/mcp/tools.json
4. GET https://api.thisisatest.tech/openapi.json

On production-like API deployments, GET /mcp/tools.json requires a key and
returns 401 without one. The other bootstrap GETs are
unauthenticated. The local quickstart exposes the catalog without a key.

Before assuming real side effects, fetch:

GET https://api.thisisatest.tech/health/dependencies

Inspect the JSON body: HTTP 200 alone does not mean every dependency is ready.
Check `status` and the selected tool's dependencies. Health never replaces
authentication or permit checks.

## Authority

Protected routes use the X-API-Key header. Free sandbox demo keys are available
at https://www.agentmiddleware.dev/ with no account needed. Production keys
are issued to design partners.

## Three minute hosted demo

The homepage presents one Python path using https://github.com/agentmiddleware/amw-demo.
Get a demo key inline, save both api_key and wallet_id, then clone the demo,
create a Python 3.10+ virtual environment, install it with `pip install -e .`,
export AMW_API_KEY and AMW_WALLET_ID, and run
`python examples/permit_echo_retry.py`. The script issues a permit for
partner.echo, calls it, retries with the same request key, and checks the
receipt offline. The curl invoke path is not published yet.

## Published receipt proof

The public proof page is:

https://www.agentmiddleware.dev/proof/

It labels the evidence as a self-issued sample issued on @@PROOF_RECEIPT_ISSUED@@,
not customer traction and not a test of the deployment running today. The exact portable receipt and matching key snapshot can be checked
offline with the standalone verifier published next to them. The receipt, key,
and verifier files are all public.

## Check it today, no access needed

Verify the published receipt offline, as on /proof/:

    curl -fsSLO https://www.agentmiddleware.dev/proof/receipt.json
    curl -fsSLO https://www.agentmiddleware.dev/proof/trust-keys.json
    curl -fsSLO https://www.agentmiddleware.dev/proof/verify_receipt.py
    python3 -m pip install cryptography
    python3 verify_receipt.py --bundle receipt.json --keys trust-keys.json \
      --expect-issuer https://api.thisisatest.tech

Keyless live calls: curl -sS https://api.thisisatest.tech/health and
https://api.thisisatest.tech/.well-known/trust-keys.json. Public API contract:
https://api.thisisatest.tech/openapi.json and https://api.thisisatest.tech/docs.
The free sandbox demo key can run the demo tool. Production tool calls need a
design partner key.

## Try the complete loop locally (public source)

No live API credentials are required. Clone
https://github.com/agentmiddleware/agent-middleware. Install Python 3.11+,
git, make, curl, and uv first; see docs/quickstart.md. Two local paths are
self-contained:

Drive it yourself (a real server, you hold the keys):

1. Run `make quickstart` from the repository root.
2. Follow docs/quickstart.md: mint your own wallet-scoped key, issue
   yourself a permit, invoke one governed tool, replay it, overspend it,
   and verify the signed receipt offline.

Watch it prove itself (no server, one command):

1. Run `make prove-trust-plane` from the repository root.

Both use a throwaway local SQLite database and real FastAPI routes. They
demonstrate permit → invoke → charge → signed receipt → replay. For a finalized
request, a retry with the same key returns the original receipt instead of
dispatching again. An action outside the permit scope is denied. These are
local proofs, not a partner owned consequential action, customer validation,
production settlement, or compliance evidence.
